title: Yellow orb tags along with Atlas launch

tellings.quote: Second stage took off. This or uh yellow orb came over and tracked the missile.

plain: In 1964 at Vandenberg Air Force Base in California, a yellow orb flew up and followed an Atlas missile after its launch, according to Richard Barth, a former guard of nuclear missiles who says he saw it. He tells Michels that once the second stage fired, "this yellow orb came over and tracked the missile," which, if true, would mean something unknown was watching US missile tests.
